listing.name: Ace Combat 5 Static Recompilation
listing.summary: Register an upstream-prepared Ace Combat 5 Windows player using your own supported USA disc and retained project data.

steps.title: Prepare your own game files with the project’s tools
steps.instruction: Complete the supported upstream build from your own Ace Combat 5: The Unsung War USA SLUS-20851 original. Its extracted SLUS_208.51 must be 3634092 bytes, SHA-256 c3594227605307806592416dbd723bf5771952e279ee281a40da305426667385. Keep the ISO or extracted disc files for runtime reads. Upstream GCC 15+, MSYS2 UCRT64 SDL3, Python, CMake/Ninja and Vulkan SDK preparation remains outside Portcove. Retain all documented overrides/hooks during generation; the shorter diagnostic CMake command is not the supported complete recipe.

steps.title: Select the completed game player
steps.instruction: Select the completed build/gcc/ac5.exe, with its creating project root as working directory. Use --data followed by the absolute generated directory containing ps2_image.bin, --disc followed by your absolute own ISO or extracted-disc directory, and --watchdog 0. That is the documented normal play command: the upstream watchdog otherwise abandons a no-field interval during the normal initial black screen. Do not select gsreplay, a compiler or a generator. Keep the adjacent shaders, SDL3.dll and libwinpthread-1.dll, with the driver Vulkan loader available.

steps.title: Allow the game to finish normally
steps.instruction: The normal player stays open for the game session until exit; --vblanks 0 is the documented default. A short diagnostic loop in the source does not establish a gameplay time limit. Portcove has not observed startup or gameplay for this route.

steps.title: Review launch details, then choose Play
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the selected game executable, working folder and launch arguments, then choose Play separately. You and the project manage setup, version changes and recovery. Removing the registration leaves all external files in place. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, migration or deletion for this copy. Before changing versions, close the game and all companions and keep the complete working copy and every data location. Review and select the executable again if its files change.

warnings: Use only a copy and components you are permitted to use. Preserve originals, required player files, saves, settings, mods, caches, logs, backups and custom locations; another executable may share them. Source inspection and test fixtures do not confirm gameplay, real saves or behavior in the installed app, or establish Supported status or protected acceptance.

references.title: Keep the working game and every data location
references.instruction: Keep the entire creating project, original ISO/extracted data, generated C/image and matching native runtime. Saves and mods are relative to the chosen working directory; PS2_SAVE_DIR overrides saves. ac5_settings.ini, ac5_pipelines.cache and ac5_pipelines.keys live beside ac5.exe. These are this runtime’s memory-card format, explicitly not PCSX2 cards. Preserve every save, setting, mod, Lua/native plugin, cache, log, backup and custom root with the creating version. Apache-2.0 project code and separate ImGui/Lua/dependency notices do not license your original game or arbitrary mods.
